question: Which cathode does Table 1's Section 6 row name, and at a 6C charging rate, what capacity did that cathode keep compared with NMC 532 and NMC 622 in the ORNL study the paper describes?
expect: NMC 811 (Table 1 'Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e. NMC 811)', a wrapped cell); 80% at 6C (2.2 mAh/cm^2) vs 49% and 56% for NMC 532 and NMC 622 (2.4 mAh/cm^2) (p7.L78-81)
rendered: The cathode is NMC 811. According to the paper, in an ORNL study, NMC 811 cathodes with an areal loading of 2.2 mA h/cm2 maintained 80% capacity at 6C charging rate, while the corresponding NMC 532 and NMC 622 cathodes with areal loadings of 2.4 mA h/cm2 only retained 49% and 56% capacity, respectively, at 6C rate.
